title: Cancel errores 409 ya done y 404 no existe
criterio: Complementa F04 (cancel success 200) validando paths de error nunca probados: POST /factory/jobs/job-f12-done01/cancel sobre job ya done/error → 409 {error regex "already (done|error)"} + POST /factory/jobs/job-notexist-99/cancel sobre job inexistente → 404 {error regex "job not found"}. PactV3 MatchersV3 headers plain application/json body {}, Windows only. factoryServer POST /cancel ya implementa 404 si !job y 409 si done/error (ver factoryServer.ts line ~596: if done/error → 409). No flaky: handler deja job en done antes de verificar.
